trigger: A stranger at the shack door before dawn.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Growling at the door. Not her Tallman shaking. A human growl. Suspicious.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A woman in a Tyvek suit under a ranch coat. Frostbitten fingers. A plastic badge: DVA — LEVEL 3.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: I saw your light. I've been walking for nine days. I'm Hollis Reyne. I'm a biologist. Was.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: I heard you on the radio before it died. You need hardened control hardware. I know where there's some.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Dixie Valley Annex. A contractor site under the Fallon ranges. We studied torpor. Hibernation biology.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: The Annex was built to survive this. EMP-shielded. Hangar full of spares. Generator room. Controls.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: The diesel ran out in September. The holds warmed. Things... woke up. You've seen them. Your dog has.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Looks at Reyne. Looks at the door. Lies down between them.]

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: [Quietly] A hundred miles east. Through Fallon. Through the Compact. Through whatever's out there.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Because I'm the reason some of them are out here. And because you have lights. I'm afraid of the dark now.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You'll need the ground power cart to open a dead facility. And a truck. And luck.
